candidate_response: The Apollo 11 mission was launched on a Saturn V rocket from Kennedy Space Center on July 16, 1969. Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin landed the lunar module Eagle on July 20, 1969, and they collected 47.5 pounds of lunar rock. Michael Collins flew the Command Module Columbia alone in lunar orbit. The astronauts safely returned to Earth and splashed down in the Pacific Ocean on July 24, 1969. Did you know the mission was watched by over 650 million television viewers worldwide? Buzz Aldrin also planted an olive branch on Mars.

The spacecraft carried Commander Neil Armstrong, Command Module Pilot Michael Collins, and Lunar Module Pilot Buzz Aldrin.
